# dsh-tavily-cxykyw
English | 中文
A Tavily-backed `WebSearchProvider` for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (`ctx.web`).
It routes the built-in `web_search` tool to Tavily's dedicated search API instead of the shipped Dee
pSeek model-based search channel, so **a search costs no model tokens** and the result set comes fro
m a real search engine index rather than an auxiliary model request.
Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`.
> Package name note: `dsh-web-search-tavily` on npm belongs to another author. This plugin is publis
hed as **`dsh-tavily-cxykyw`**; the GitHub repository is still `cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily`.
## What it does

- registers a search provider with the stable id **`tavily`** on `ctx.web`;
- maps Tavily's response
to DSH's normalized `WebSearchResult` — `results[].url/title/content` become `sources[].url/title/s

nippet`, and Tavily's optional `answer` becomes the result `content`;
- resolves the API key on **ev
ery** search, in this order: literal `apiKey` → credentials service (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) → l

aunch environment / `process.env`;
- `available()` is a cheap local check (key + base URL present) w

ith no network calls — a missing key surfaces as `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` at search time;
-
then truncates to `request.maxResults` through the seam, exactly like any other provider.

> **Never commit an API key.** This repository, its `cordis.patch.yml`, and its published npm tarbal
l contain **no** credentials and no default key: the plugin only ever reads them from your machine a
t search time. `.gitignore` also excludes `.env*`, `.npmrc`, and `*.local.yml`.
## Options
Configurable on the inserted `web-search-tavily` row:
| Option | Default | Description |

| `apiKey` | — | Literal Tavily API key. Prefer `apiKeyEnv` + credentials/env. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `TA

VILY_API_KEY` | Credential reference / environment variable name to resolve the key from. |
| `baseU

RL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Tavily API base URL (point it at a proxy if you need one). |
| `sea

rchDepth` | `basic` | `basic` (fast, 1 credit) or `advanced` (deeper crawl, more credits). |
| `maxR
esults` | `8` | Results requested per search, 1–20. A per-call `maxResults` still wins. |

## Switching providers
The bundle patch already pins the seam:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
To fall back to the official DeepSeek search, set `searchProvider: deepseek-official` (or remove the
line only if `deepseek-official` is the single usable provider — with two usable providers and no p
in, the seam fails closed with `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`).
> Upgrading from a hand-inserted copy in your own profile patch? Delete that `insert` block and keep
only the `- id: web-search-tavily` config override above, otherwise the row id is inserted twice.
## Notes and limitations
- No Web settings page: DSH `0.2` cannot mount this plugin's settings section, so the provider is co

nfigured through the profile patch only.
- `fetch` (page retrieval) is untouched — it stays on `@dee

pseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`.
- Tavily search results carry no publication date, so `sources[].publi

tch-http`.
- Tavily search results carry no publication date, so `sources[].publishedAt` is not set.
